messages:
maria-sec: Quick sync — need alignment on audit event lexicon + visibility flags before RBAC/KMS rollout. Short goals: stable public names, internal fields for diffs, visibility/sensitivity gating.
sam-infra: SGTM. Do we already have a proposed minimal mapping we can iterate on?
maria-sec: Pasting concise proposal (will link full CSV after):

```
// public_name | verb | object | actor_type

"api_key.create" | "create" | "api_key" | "service_account"
"user.login" | "authenticate" | "user_session" | "human_user"
"kms.key.rotate" | "rotate" | "kms_key" | "system"
```

maria-sec: Notes: public_name is what's exported to customers; verb/object are canonical schema fields. actor_type used by RBAC UI and forensics.
kevin-prod: For RBAC migrations we must capture role diffs. Propose fields: `actor.previous_roles` (list) and `actor.new_roles` (list) + `actor.effective_roles`. Without those you can't prove escalation.
olivia-sre: +1. Add `request.origin.ip` and `request.origin.geo` for incident response traces.
maria-sec: Agreed. Also propose short names: `actor.prev_roles`, `actor.new_roles`, `request.origin.ip`, `request.origin.region`. Keep fields concise.
jonathan-plat: KMS question: should `kms.key_id` be in public exports? Concern: ARNs leak. My suggestion: public exports get `kms.key_alias` only; internal logs keep full ARN (`kms.arn`) behind restricted access.
maria-sec: That matches our privacy policy. Public = PII-free, customer-visible identifiers only. Internal logs (support/sec roles) include full `kms.arn` and envelope metadata.
sam-infra: How do we mark events as exportable vs internal? Add `event.visibility` enum?
maria-sec: Yes — `event.visibility: public|internal|restricted`. Plus `event.sensitivity: low|medium|high`. Sensitivity gates retention and export.
kevin-prod: API teams need compatibility promises. Any renames must include aliasing for at least 90 days. Suggest adding `public_name_v2` in mapping and a console alias table.
maria-sec: We'll provide compatibility layer in export tooling. ACTION: security to publish canonical CSV + migration checklist by Friday EOD.
olivia-sre: Product validation needed — 3 customer-facing examples to sanity-check mapping: 1) `api_key.create` 2) `delegation.grant` 3) `kms.key.rotate`. Need wording that maps to SIEM.
jonathan-plat: I can populate the example payloads and coordinate with early access customers.
maria-sec: Naming rules (proposal): singular nouns, lowercase, dot-delimited, avoid infra hints. Eg `deployment.rollback` not `k8s_deployment_rollback`. Preferred verbs: create, delete, update, rotate, grant, revoke, authenticate, authorize.
kevin-prod: +1. Also recommend we publish a short allowed-verb whitelist in the CSV.
olivia-sre: I'll draft QA checklist: schema lint, sample-export smoke test, SIEM-ingest test (evt->splunk/syslog), RBAC rollback test.
maria-sec: sample event payload (public export example):

```json
{
  "event": "api_key.create",
  "verb": "create",
  "object": "api_key",
  "actor": {
    "id": "acct-1234",
    "type": "service_account"
  },
  "request": {
    "origin": { "ip": "203.0.113.45", "region": "us-west-2" }
  },
  "event.visibility": "public",
  "event.sensitivity": "low"
}
```

maria-sec: Internal-only debug variant (kept out of public exports): includes `actor.prev_roles`, `actor.new_roles`, `kms.arn`, `trace_id`.
sam-infra: Implementation note: we'll add `event.visibility` tag in the logging layer. Exporter will filter and redact based on visibility + sensitivity.
kevin-prod: Also need a migration endpoint that returns mapping aliases so customers can map old names -> new. Expose in console and via /audit/mapping API.
maria-sec: Good. We'll include `mapping_version` and `deprecated_since` fields in CSV.
jonathan-plat: Ops ask: when rolling out RBAC changes, we should ship a 2-week overlap window where both old and new public_name keys appear in exports, with `deprecated_since` set.
olivia-sre: Add automated smoke test: spin up small consumer that ingests sample exported events to their SIEM mapping to catch naming regressions.
maria-sec: Final checklist items before merge: canonical CSV in /docs/audit-event-lexicon, migration checklist, console alias UI, exporter redact rules, QA smoke tests. I'll tag owners in the doc.
audit-bot: CSV uploaded: /docs/audit-event-lexicon/lexicon-202503.csv :white_check_mark:
maria-sec: Thanks. Closing the thread — will follow up with payload examples and migration doc.
kevin-prod: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
